name: repo-template-basic
title_zh: 新仓库从模板一键长出来，目录文件设置全同款
tagline_zh: 别再每个新项目都手搓一遍 .gitignore、CI 和文件夹结构。定一次母版。
tagline_en: Stop hand-copying .gitignore, CI, and folder trees for every new project. Define the master once, generate.
desc_en: A master project structure that lets you quickly generate new repositories with identical files, folders, and settings
why_zh: 把「仓库骨架」本身当成可版本化的资产。母版改了，后续生成的新仓库自动继承。
why_en: Treat your repo skeleton as versionable asset. Update the master, future repos inherit automatically. No more copy-paste drift.
limit_zh: 只负责生成初始结构和配置，不含代码逻辑、依赖管理或部署。模板更新不会同步到已生成的仓库，需自行迁移。
limit_en: Only scaffolds initial structure & config. No code logic, deps, or deployment. Template updates don't propagate to already-generated repos.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
